documentation_gaps.title: README构建命令缺少环境变量设置说明
documentation_gaps.body: README 5.5章节的构建命令未说明需要设置LD_LIBRARY_PATH和CPPFLAGS环境变量。hucx/xucg作为独立安装的依赖库，其库路径和头文件路径需要手动设置环境变量才能被hmpi的configure和make正确找到。具体需要：export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/install/hucx/lib:/workspace/install/xucg/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH; export CPPFLAGS=-I/workspace/install/hucx/include -I/workspace/install/xucg/include; export LDFLAGS=-L/workspace/install/hucx/lib -L/workspace/install/xucg/lib

documentation_gaps.title: README构建命令在aarch64平台触发shortfloat扩展Fortran编译错误
documentation_gaps.body: README的configure命令未排除shortfloat扩展。在aarch64平台（鲲鹏920）上gfortran支持_Float16类型，导致shortfloat扩展启用并在mpi_f08_ext模块中使用type(MPI_Datatype)，但该模块缺少use mpi_f08导入语句。需要添加--enable-mpi-ext=affinity,cuda,pcollreq排除shortfloat扩展才能成功编译

problems_encountered.problem: hmpi configure失败：UCG support requested but not found
problems_encountered.solution: 设置LD_LIBRARY_PATH包含hucx/xucg库路径，使configure链接测试能解析libucg.so对libucs.so.0的依赖

problems_encountered.problem: hmpi make失败：coll_ucg_module.c编译时找不到ucp/api/ucp.h头文件
problems_encountered.solution: 在CPPFLAGS中添加-I/workspace/install/hucx/include，使coll_ucg组件能找到hucx的头文件（coll_ucg_CPPFLAGS仅包含xucg路径，缺少hucx路径）

problems_encountered.problem: hmpi make失败：Fortran编译mpi_f08_ext模块时shortfloat扩展使用未导入的MPI_Datatype类型（Derived type 'mpi_datatype' is being used before it is defined）
problems_encountered.solution: configure添加--enable-mpi-ext=affinity,cuda,pcollreq禁用shortfloat扩展。该扩展在aarch64上检测到_Float16类型支持后启用模块级type(MPI_Datatype)声明，但mpi_f08_ext模块缺少use mpi_f08语句导入该类型
